notes.title: 🐔🌟Exciting News: Chicken Coop Demo Now Available! 🌟🐔
notes.content:
🐔🌟 Exciting News: Chicken Coop Demo Now Available! 🌟🐔

Attention all aspiring farmers and animal lovers! We're thrilled to announce that the demo version of Chicken Coop is finally here, ready for you to dive into the whimsical world of farming fun!

In this delightful demo, you'll get a taste of farm life as you build structures, plant crops, and care for your adorable chickens. Explore the colorful surroundings, interact with charming farm animals, and experience the joy of nurturing your very own farm.

Please note that this demo is a preview of the full game and some features may not be complete. However, it's a fantastic opportunity to get a sneak peek at what's to come and provide valuable feedback to help shape the final release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43501432/3cef057a68b3f6cdaa3a60367e16c9e33149560f.png[/img]

Whether you're a seasoned farm sim enthusiast or a newcomer to the genre, there's something for everyone to enjoy in the Chicken Coop demo. So grab your pitchfork and get ready to embark on an unforgettable farming adventure!

Download the demo now on Steam and start building your dream farm today. Don't forget to wishlist Chicken Coop to stay updated on future news and releases. Happy farming! 🌾🚜

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43501432/455812cbc6be719df035871cd5c51e93dbf42170.png[/img]

notes.title: Chicken Coop - Spring is coming!
notes.content:
[h1]Branching Out: Snappy Tree Update Unveils Custom Planks & Logs[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43501432/8fc513e587aff0eb84594bf73244921e99a5a52b.png[/img]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jXSvZW6wFiQ

[h2]🌳🔨 Patch Update: New Trees & Custom Planks! 🌳🔨[/h2]

In this exciting patch, we've introduced trees to your farm! Use their sturdy trunks as building materials and craft unique planks. Plus, check out these awesome additions:

🖼️ World Images for Tasks: Get visual cues for tasks and queue up tree-chopping tasks with ease!
🌳 Daily Tree Growth: Watch as new trees sprout on your farm every day.
🦙 Fresh Alpaca Animations: Enjoy adorable new animations for your furry friends.
🏠 Animal Stalls: Keep your animals cozy in their new homes.
🐔 More Guidance from the Rooster: Stay informed with helpful tips from the rooster, now with an exclamation mark when he has something new to share.

🔄 Revamped Startup: Experience smoother startup handling.
🔍 Redesigned Agent Selection: Navigate the agent selection view with improved clarity.
🛠️ Task Management Overhaul: Enjoy a total remake of the task management system.
🍽️ Food Tray Remake: Indulge in a total remake of food and feeding trays.

Update now and let your farm thrive with these exciting new features! 🌟


[h2]Hi![/h2]
It's been a while! Finally time for some new stuff!

Since the game has been unplayable for almost 5 months due to the many bugs after the task/game startup overhaul, I have taken the time necessary to make this patch as stable as possible.

Best regards!
Coolof

notes.title: Autumn Atmosphere & Playful Pups Update
notes.content:
[h1]Autumn Atmosphere & Playful Pups Update[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43501432/c537d2ed76223b54e4afee5be317caf8f5813fe3.png[/img]

[h2]1. Playful Pups! Who's a Good Dog?:[/h2]
Our furry friends steal the spotlight with new animations - sitting, digging, dancing, and even double the sleeping cuteness. Meet our new and improved dog model, complete with animations, collars, and textures. This dog is the epitome of goodness!

[h2]2. Autumn Atmosphere and Farmyard Harmony:[/h2]
Immerse yourself in the soothing vibes of autumn. Enjoy enhanced dusk and dawn blending, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere on the farm. Start your day with the delightful sound of the rooster's cock-a-doodle-doo when morning arrives. We've introduced a proof of concept global volume control for smoother transitions during dusk and dawn.

[h2]3. Space Chicken and Fashionable Chickens:[/h2]
Watch space chickens slow down their walk and run animations for added entertainment. Our fashionable chickens sport a variety of adorable hats, including builder, military, farmer, and astronaut, each with specialized animations depending on the hat.

[h2]4. Farmstead Renovations and Pizza Excitement:[/h2]
The farm gets a makeover with new bricks and textures, while the pizza oven adds a dash of excitement. We've also fixed various issues, from broken references to crash fixes, making your farm experience even more enjoyable.

[h2]5. Farm Safety and Efficiencies:[/h2]
We've ensured a smoother experience with various crash fixes and improved shutdown procedures. Farm management is now more enjoyable with proof of concept status and equipped tool icons on the top bar. Significant changes have been made to how statuses are handled for improved efficiency.

[h2]Shoutout to Cecilia - Our Animator Extraordinaire:[/h2]
A heartfelt shoutout to Cecilia, our talented animator who brings the farm to life with her creativity and dedication. Her work adds that extra sparkle to our animations and makes your farm experience truly special. Find more of her work at [url=https://www.artstation.com/cecilialof]artstation[/url].


Have a nice day!
/Olof

notes.title: Rooster Guidance & Clarity Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43501432/780b74162b71f71278bc5b77da7cd844fbbe4dca.png[/img][olist]

[*] Clearer UI and Streamlined Achievements:
We've revamped the user interface (UI) to provide a clearer and more user-friendly experience. Achievements now seamlessly integrate into your gameplay, ensuring that nothing disrupts your farming adventure.

[*] Simultaneous Chick Management:
Now, you can manage multiple chicks simultaneously, adding depth and efficiency to your farm management. The wise and tired rooster will guide you through this new capability, making your farm life even more enjoyable.

[*] Peaceful Farm Life:
Say goodbye to interruptions while managing your slumbering chickens. We've resolved issues that were causing crashes, guaranteeing uninterrupted tranquility on your farm.

[*] Top Bar Stability:
Rotating top bars are a thing of the past. We've addressed issues related to top bars becoming rotated after certain in-game events, ensuring a stable and visually pleasing experience.

[*] Smooth Startup:
No more startup hiccups. We've eliminated intermittent null references that occasionally surfaced after launching the game, providing a smoother and hassle-free beginning to your farm life.

[*] Wise Rooster's Guidance:
The wise and tired rooster takes center stage as your guide to clearer gameplay. Rooster events are now expertly managed, enhancing your understanding of the game and its mechanics.

[*] Serene Sunlight and Delightful Animations:
Experience the serene beauty of daytime sunlight, with soothing hues that elevate the overall atmosphere. Additionally, enjoy smoother chicken animations with randomized speeds, adding a delightful touch to your farm life.

[*] Farming Clarity:
Get ready for a more intuitive and enjoyable farming experience as the Guidance & Clarity Update takes you by the hand, led by the wise rooster. Discover newfound clarity in your farm management and storytelling.

[/olist]
[previewyoutube=7YmUtXWNUvI;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Summer Serenity Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43501432/7b1175150fed5d32419906acadacc0f123c1d0e7.png[/img]
[olist]
[*] Handpick Your Feathered Crew:
Experience the joy of selecting your own crew of chickens. Each chicken is unique and comes with its own personality, adding a delightful layer of strategy to your farm management.

[*] Enchanted Tooltips and Visuals:
Experience gameplay with a touch of magic as tooltips elegantly fade in and out, seamlessly providing essential information. The UI art has been carefully crafted to enhance your immersion, making every interaction a delightful experience.

[*] Lunar Ambiance:
As the sun sets, a new enchantment unfolds with the change in fog color during nighttime. This visual transformation adds an extra layer of charm to the world you explore.

[*] Refined Button Interaction:
Navigating through the game has never been smoother. Buttons now respond more intuitively, ensuring that agent priorities and Building View controls feel responsive and intuitive.

[*] Focused Construction:
With Building View enhancements, your construction endeavors are more streamlined than ever. Buttons no longer recreate, allowing you to build your dream farm without interruptions.

[*] Clarity and Personal Touch:
Details matter, and we've ensured they're just right. Agent names are now more accurate, the top bar visuals are enhanced, and Chickens have their own unique names, adding a personal touch to your farming adventure.

[*] Enhanced Animal Bonds:
Your connection with the animals has deepened with improved sleep spot handling and the introduction of Save/Load options for all animals. Your virtual companions now enjoy a more realistic and caring interaction.

[*] Return to a Refreshed World:
Step back into the world of the game, now imbued with the serenity and charm of the Summer Serenity Update. Dive into a gaming experience that's been carefully crafted to provide you with tranquil enjoyment.
[/olist]

notes.title: Release 230626 is here! Refreshing bright UI and more!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43501432/6850b6697655299ba624e6fd9a99de6de9473359.png[/img]

🌟 Patch Notes 🌟

[h2]Brighter UI[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Tooltip now magically appears closer to where your eyes are resting, like a helpful little companion.
[*] The UI backgrounds are now consistently brighter, accompanied by spruced up dark texts.
[/list]

[h2]New Content[/h2]
[list]
[*] The adorable cat now has a cozy pillow to sleep on. It's like a dream come true! (Note: The pillow is currently activated from the start, but in the future, it will be unlocked during gameplay.)
[*] Our delightful golden retriever now has a brand new dog house building. They finally have their very own happy place!
[/list]

[h2]Reworked Task Priorities[/h2]
After some playtesting and listening to your feedback, we realized that some tasks were causing confusion. So, we've worked our magic to make it easier for you to control what takes priority.
Now, when you queue up tool creation at a workbench or when a plant needs watering, this is top prio for your workforce.

Wishing you a day filled with joy and delightful adventures!

/Olof

notes.title: Llamas arrive! They will protect us from the pesky foxes!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43501432/fb907951ae3b94531dfd0f3c49853dec2704e5ce.png[/img]
[h1]Patch Notes (20230612)[/h1]
[h2]Llamas[/h2]
Cecilia did it again! The Llamas have joined the farm!
[list]
[*] Two Llamas have joined the farm
[*] In the future, they will be used as guardians. For now, they just eat the harvested crops.
[/list]
[h2]New Post Processing[/h2]
Cecilia and Olof have joined efforts in a new style of post processing. We are really satisfied with the results! Are you?
[list]
[*] Improved Post processing for day and night
[*] Improved lighting
[*] Altered Day/Night cycle
[/list]
[h2]UI Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Building Menu has been visually improved, even if it is a work in process.
[*] New types of Tooltip depending on View
[*] New types of Camera handling depending on View
[/list]
[h2]Preparing for animation rigging[/h2]
We have been working on solutions for using procedural animations in some events.
The only part that made this patch was:
[list]
[*] Chickens now stop when you hover them. In the future they may look at the camera as well.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Sun flare was bugged at night in some angles
[*] Paint task was not saved properly
[/list]

notes.title: Release 20230529 is here! More Rooster Action!
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes 20230529[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43501432/cf38d93ccda97d2c21022ae85fe2edc0b4ef4657.png[/img]
[h2]Game Speed[/h2]
Player being in control of Game speed has been in the game since the beginning. But now it is possible to move around and place buildings etc when the game is paused.
[h2]UI Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Top Bar has been visually improved, together with the addition of the new Game Speed buttons.
[*] Bot Bar has gotten the same visual treatment, using buttons instead of texts.
[*] Build Menu has been moved to a horizontal view instead.
[/list]
[h2]Rooster Love[/h2]
The Rooster has had some bugs and unclear behaviour.
Now he is more consistent and the dialogs are better at telling the player what the rooster wants.
Also, he now actually makes a romantic dance with the mother before she lays her egg.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Chicks that grew up were completely bugged out when reaching adulthood
[*] Some cases caused lag spikes due to cursor swapping
[*] Minor issues with tasks not being resetted properly
[/list]

notes.title: Release 20230515 is finally here
notes.content:
[h1]Patch notes[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43501432/df072e91cb3cf1361ca77b59ac01c8350ca2aee9.png[/img]
[h2]Art and model updates[/h2]
Cecilia, the creator of the chickens, is a remarkably talented 3D artist. She has been diligently working on new rigs and animations, breathing life into each and every chicken. You can explore more of her incredible work at https://www.artstation.com/cecilialof. Throughout the game's development, Cecilia has played a crucial role, directly and indirectly shaping its journey. In this latest patch, her addition of new art and models has breathed fresh life into the game, making it feel truly alive. 

[h2]Chicken2.0[/h2]
The new Chicken 2.0 has now arrived to the homestead, with many new animations, such as:
[list]
[*] Dancing while watering the plants [b]new[/b]
[*] Flying [b]new[/b]
[*] Sleeping [b]improved[/b]
[*] Walk [b]improved[/b]
[*] Run [b]improved[/b]
[*] Carry heavy [b]new[/b]
[*] Use Hammer/pickaxe [b]new[/b]
[/list]

[h2]Rooster[/h2]
We also added a new character - the Rooster. He is the typical "latte dad". He helps out by eating the food and feeling tired, while keeping track of how many eggs are in the coop. He is really proud of himself.

[h2]Minor changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] New textures for the terrain
[*] New cursor
[*] Solves bug where buildings could not be destroyed
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 20230501 is here!
notes.content:
[h1]Patch 20230501[/h1]
[h2]Better camera control and UI[/h2]
[list]
[*] Some large UI views caused users to lose track of what they were doing. Adjusts the camera view to manage this.
[*] Multiple minor UI improvements, both in Main Menu and in-game.
[*] Using object pools for shared UI elements results in a performance increase. 
[/list]
[h2]Save Your Game[/h2]
[list]
[*] Saves the game once per night and when played wants to.
[*] Loads the game on startup
[*] Main menu adjusted to deal with this + resetting save files
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed UI bugs caused by pooling
[*] Fixes issue where tools fell through ground
[*] Cut Scene buttons were not always working
[/list]
[h2]Known Limitations[/h2]
[list]
[*] Dog has a "Fetch" button that is not doing anything
[*] Walls are not saved yet
[*] The painted buildings does not save color adjusted by player yet
[*] Materials on the ground are not saved
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43501432/fa42e1a549b8fd426dc6c584feedf40dbfb3194f.png[/img]
